parts.radioSource: ESP32-S3-MINI-1 & MINI-1U datasheet v1.7: Bluetooth LE transmit 189 mA at 0 dBm and receive 93 mA (Table 6-5); Wi-Fi 802.11b transmit up to 355 mA peak (Table 6-4); external supply at least 0.5 A, 3.3 V
parts.notes: The robot MCU when the ESP32-C3's pins run out: 39 GPIOs (the C3-MINI-1 has 15) and four hardware pulse counters (PCNT) that decode both encoder channels in quadrature (ESP32-S3 Technical Reference Manual, Pulse Count Controller). ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8: 8 MB flash, no PSRAM, so GPIO26 is free (datasheet v1.7, Table 3-1 note b). Its USB Serial/JTAG controller on GPIO19 (USB_D-) and GPIO20 (USB_D+) programs it over USB-C with no bridge; UART0 on GPIO43/GPIO44 (TXD0/RXD0). Strapping pins GPIO0, GPIO3, GPIO45, GPIO46: GPIO0 low at reset enters download boot (GPIO46 must then be low, its default pull-down); keep GPIO3/45/46 free of loads that pull them at reset. Currents (datasheet v1.7, 3.3 V, 25 °C): dual core at 240 MHz 66.2 mA (Table 6-6), deep sleep 8 µA (Table 6-7). Firmware simulation: none here (Xtensa; the drive simulation runs on the ESP32-C3 in QEMU riscv32), so an S3 robot's report says drive sim not run. LCSC C2913206, a JLCPCB extended part, $4.68 each or $3.32 at 100 (jlcsearch, 17 Nov 2026).
parts.reason: moved up from the ESP32-C3-MINI-1: 12 signals need pins free at reset (ENC_LA, ENC_LB, ENC_RA, ENC_RB for quadrature), it has 8; the ESP32-S3-MINI-1 has 31 and hardware quadrature counters (PCNT)
Brief: "Temperature and humidity sensing ... about ±0.2 °C and ±2 %RH": the SHT40 gives ±0.2 °C and ±1.8 %RH typical over I2C
Brief: "Runs on one Li-ion cell for at least 6 months": a 2 µA quiescent regulator for the 3.3 V rail, rated for the module's 0.5 A
Brief: "USB-C for charging and for flashing firmware. Nobody should need a special cable"

parts.notes: 6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) on the I2C bus, on every robot board (the user, 17 Nov 2026: "Every robot"): the turns close on the gyro's heading, the wheel encoders still give the distance. 1.71-3.6 V, 0.45 mA (gyro and accelerometer at 208 Hz, Table 4). Wired by the board generator: SCL/SDA to the bus, VDD and VDDIO to 3V3 with 100 nF each (Table 2 note 1), CS to VDDIO (I2C mode), SA0/SDx/SCx to GND (address 0x6A, Mode 1), INT1/INT2/NC open. Gyro: CTRL2_G (11h) = 0x44 (104 Hz, +/-500 dps), 17.5 mdps/LSB (Table 3), OUTZ_L_G/OUTZ_H_G (26h/27h).
